title: Training Note: Workforce Adoption Pricing of the Paystride Per-Worker Fee
content:
**What is measured?** Workforce adoption discounts the per-worker fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement by the share of the month's eligible headcount that the month's enrolled active workers make up on the census, a census with no eligible headcount giving a share of zero.

**What discount does each share give?** Where the share is at least 0.6 (60 percent), the discount is 4 percent; where it is at least 0.3 (30 percent) but below 0.6, it is 2 percent; otherwise there is no adoption discount.

**Which census is used?** The census of the billing month: its enrolled active workers and its eligible headcount.

**How do the boundaries fall?** (hypothetical censuses of 1000 eligible employees)

| Enrolled active workers | Share | Adoption discount |
|---|---|---|
| 600 | 0.6 | 4 percent |
| 599 | 0.599 | 2 percent |
| 300 | 0.3 | 2 percent |
| 299 | 0.299 | none |

A census reporting no eligible headcount gives a share of zero and no adoption discount.
